notes.title: February Update
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone!
This month has been very busy, and I’m excited to show you what I’ve been working on for Binary Golf:


[h3][b]Episode 2: Sahara Forest[/b][/h3]
Episode 2 takes you on an adventure with Batal, and his sister Hana, and their mom as they explore a mysterious forest, featuring 2 new [b]Super Targets:[/b]

[b]The Teleporter:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41980726/4ce6067651e5a003aa3eabd09e58d0f897a3531e.gif[/img]
[b]Summon a Tele Dot at the ball’s position[/b] then [b]press (C) again to teleport[/b] back into said Tele Dot, destroying it in the process, you can also move the Tele Dot with arrow keys (horizontally only).
This ability is a bit complex tbh, but the holes make it a bit simpler.

[b]The Fire:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41980726/b7f5fb5664a71cebe944e73d12eaa8b930706495.gif[/img]
[b]Move very fast for 0.5 seconds and float in mid-air [/b]then slow down and drop, this ability is difficult for sure, but still the holes in Episode 2 don’t require hard execution.


[h3][b]New look for the Secret Warp[/b][/h3]
Here is a comparison, for both warps:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41980726/0b4a38f6052b86b8251e52ab07e47a352a113dfe.gif[/img]
So, what do you think?


[h3][b]Color Mode, Static Background Options[/b][/h3]
To enhance the experience for some people who find the game too bright, I’ve added an option for Color Mode, there are 3 choices: 
[b]Vibrant Mode (default):[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41980726/6d8314400f743135e818ddcf7c7c91afdafef823.png[/img]
[b]Eyestrain Mode:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41980726/71f96c05ccd40fd4e1e062b5cec2c7b92a9c9b12.png[/img]
[b]Night Mode:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41980726/82a573a2ec38c29edd5e2d9d72b7efbd63e2eb30.png[/img]
I also added Static Background, which from the name, makes ALL backgrounds hold still, even the main menu.


[h3][b]Reworked Options Layout[/b][/h3]
The Options Menu has been re-organized for easier navigation, splitting them into 6 categories:
[olist]
[*] Sound
[*] Graphics
[*] Controller Remap
[*] Keyboard Remap
[*] Game Settings
[*] Accessibility
[/olist]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41980726/8e95cab4ec09563d561eb3bf6b1d461e679d0c7b.gif[/img]


[h3][b]How to Play section[/b][/h3]
For those who forgot some basic mechanics about the game, this would be a refresher, it also tells what ALL abilities do and some [b]pro tips[/b] that you would need for the later courses.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41980726/2affc5834fa90d0886fd68b504ffd03a4ee17b57.gif[/img]
That’s NOT the main way to learn the game, btw, there is an interactive tutorial when you start the game.
Anyway that’s all for this month, see you soon.
